sections.name: Part 1: General Knowledge & Logical Reasoning (सामान्य ज्ञान एवं तार्किक ज्ञान)
Part 2: Intellectual Ability & Mental Aptitude (बौद्धिक क्षमता एवं मानसिक अभिरुचि)
Part 3: Science & Simple Arithmetic (विज्ञान एवं सरल अंकगणित)

subjects.name: General Knowledge, MP Special GK & Current Affairs (सामान्य ज्ञान, मध्यप्रदेश सामान्य ज्ञान एवं समसामयिकी)
domains: Geography & Demography of Madhya Pradesh: Districts, Rivers (Narmada, Tapti, Chambal, Betwa, Son, Ken), Plateaus (Malwa, Bundelkhand, Baghelkhand, Rewa-Panna, Satpura), Soils & Minerals (Diamond in Panna, Copper in Malanjkhand)
History & Freedom Movement in MP: Chandrashekhar Azad (Bhabhra), Rani Laxmibai, Tantya Bhil, Bheema Nayak, Holkars, Scindias, Paramaras (Raja Bhoj), Chandela Dynasty (Khajuraho temples)
Art, Culture & Tribal Heritage of MP: Gond, Bhil, Baiga, Sahariya, Korku, Bharia tribes, Bhagoria Haat, Pithora painting, Fairs (Simhastha Kumbh Ujjain, Tansen Samaroh Gwalior)
National Parks & Wildlife Sanctuaries: Kanha Tiger Reserve, Bandhavgarh, Panna, Pench, Kuno National Park (Cheetah reintroduction), Madhav, Van Vihar
Indian Constitution & Polity: Preamble, Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles, Parliament, MP Vidhan Sabha (230 seats), Panchayati Raj (73rd Amendment, MP 1st implementation)
MP Police Administration: Motto ('Desh Bhakti, Jan Seva'), Structure, Director General of Police (DGP), Special Armed Force (SAF), Hawk Force (Anti-Naxal), Cyber Crime, Dial 100/112
National & MP Current Affairs, Government Welfare Schemes (Ladli Behna Yojana, Sambal Yojana), Sports (MP Shikhar Khel Awards, Malkhamb as State Sport)

subjects.name: Reasoning Ability, Mental Aptitude & Intellectual Ability (तार्किक ज्ञान, बौद्धिक क्षमता एवं मानसिक अभिरुचि)
domains: Analogies & Semantic Classification (Word, Letter, Number)
Coding-Decoding: Letter shifting, Symbol replacement, Matrix and Numerical coding
Number Series, Alphabet Series & Missing Character in Figures
Blood Relations: Coded blood relations, Family tree deductions
Direction and Distance Sense: Angles, Pythagoras theorem based turns, Shadow problems
Order & Ranking, Seating Arrangement (Linear and Circular)
Logical Venn Diagrams, Syllogisms (Statements and Conclusions)
Mathematical Operations, Symbol substitution & Inequality relations
Non-Verbal Reasoning: Mirror images, Water images, Paper folding, Paper cutting, Embedded figures, Pattern completion
Mental Aptitude & Police Judgment: Law and order attitude, Public relations, Communal harmony, Rule of law, Basic professional ethics

subjects.name: Simple Arithmetic & Quantitative Aptitude (सरल अंकगणित एवं संख्यात्मक योग्यता)
domains: Number System: Divisibility rules, Prime numbers, Unit digit calculation, Remainders, Square roots & Cube roots
LCM and HCF: Applications in bells, runners and fraction LCM/HCF
Simplification: BODMAS rule, Fractions, Decimals, Surds & Indices
Percentages & Applications: Price increase/decrease, Population growth, Voting problems
Ratio & Proportion: Proportions, Direct & Inverse variation, Ages, Partnership
Averages: Weighted average, Batsman/bowler averages, Replacement problems
Profit, Loss & Discount: Cost price, Selling price, Marked price, Successive discounts, Dishonest shopkeeper
Simple & Compound Interest: Annual, Half-yearly compounding, Difference between CI and SI for 2 & 3 years
Time and Work: Men-days formula, Efficiency, Pipes and Cisterns
Time, Speed and Distance: Train crossings, Relative speed, River boat and stream problems, Average speed
Mensuration 2D & 3D: Area and perimeter of rectangle, square, triangle, circle; Surface area and volume of cylinder, cone, cube, sphere

subjects.name: General Science - Physics, Chemistry & Life Sciences (सामान्य विज्ञान - भौतिकी, रसायन एवं जीव विज्ञान)
domains: Physics - Mechanics & Motion: Newton's laws of motion, Gravitation, Work, Energy, Power, Kinetic and Potential energy, Friction
Physics - Light & Optics: Reflection, Refraction, Concave/Convex mirrors and lenses, Human eye defects (Myopia, Hypermetropia), Dispersion of light
Physics - Electricity, Magnetism & Heat: Ohm's law, Resistance in series and parallel, Electric power, Heat transfer (Conduction, Convection, Radiation), Latent heat
Chemistry - Matter & Structure of Atom: States of matter, Sub-atomic particles (Proton, Neutron, Electron), Atomic number, Mass number, Isotopes
Chemistry - Chemical Reactions & Periodic Classification: Types of reactions, Acids, Bases and Salts, pH scale, Metals and Non-metals, Modern Periodic Table
Chemistry - Everyday Chemistry: Common salts (NaCl, NaHCO3, Na2CO3, Bleaching powder, Plaster of Paris), Hardness of water, Polymers, Alloys
Biology - Cell & Tissues: Plant cell vs Animal cell, Cell organelles (Mitochondria, Chloroplast, Ribosome, Nucleus), Plant and animal tissues
Biology - Human Anatomy & Physiology: Digestive system, Circulatory system (Heart, Blood groups), Respiratory system, Nervous system, Excretory system (Kidney)
Biology - Health, Diseases & Nutrition: Vitamins, Carbohydrates, Proteins, Deficiency diseases, Viral and Bacterial diseases (Tuberculosis, Malaria, Dengue), Vaccines
Ecology & MP Biodiversity: Ecosystem, Food chain, Food web, Environmental conservation, MP State Animals (Barasingha / Swamp Deer), State Bird (Dudhraj / Paradise Flycatcher), State Tree (Banyan)
